verdict.rationale: OpenCode documents several headless and CI paths: the one-shot `opencode run` command, `opencode serve` as a headless HTTP server with an OpenAPI endpoint, `--auto` permission approval for unattended runs, and execution of tasks inside GitHub Actions runners. A community user also confirms running it via `opencode serve`. missing for 10: documented machine-readable output formats and exit-code behavior for generic CI pipelines, independent hands-on corroboration of CI-runner usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The opencode serve command runs a headless HTTP server that exposes an OpenAPI endpoint that an opencode client can use.
Mention /opencode or /oc in your comment, and OpenCode will execute tasks within your GitHub Actions runner.
Start OpenCode with `--auto` to automatically approve permission requests that are not explicitly denied.
opencode run "Explain how closures work in JavaScript"
You can start a service via 'opencode serve', it can be accessed from anywhere
